content:
alice: FYI canary in eu-west 2 failing post-helm apply. deploy-bot reported ConfigMap splay mismatch for service-prs.
ben: saw the alert, are we talking about values.yaml -> configmap sync drift?
alice: yes, values changed autoscaler.splay from 30s -> 5s, but the ConfigMap template still expects 30s; pods flapping.
carol: that would explain the 503s during cold-start. canary CPU stays fine but readiness probes fail.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] 2330001235 - Canary deployment r-2026.03.20-euwest-12 reported 15% unhealthy, aborted automatic rollforward.
sre-oncall: Can we roll back the values only? rolling back whole chart hurts other changes in this release.
ben: we can patch the values in the canary namespace to restore splay=30s: `kubectl -n canary patch cm app-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"splay":"30"}}'` and re-run helm upgrade --reuse-values for the canary.
alice: good short-term plan. If that stabilizes for 10m we let main rollout continue, otherwise full rollback.
carol: agree. Who will run the patch? I can do it now, will post outcome.
carol: (after) patched and restarted readiness probe. logs show fewer probe failures.
sre-oncall: monitor for 10m, if errors <1% we let deploy-bot continue. If not, we need rollback criteria: 5m sustained >5% errors -> rollback chart to v1.8.11.
ben: documenting rollout decision in release notes: add line under "Post-deploy fixes" -> "hotfix: restored config splay to 30s in canary to avoid readiness flapping; full chart rollback to v1.8.11 if error rate stays >5% for 5m".
alice: also create a short incident blurb for ops channel in case it recurs during tomorrow's change window.
carol: canary stable for 12m now, readiness failures down to 0.2%. recommend continue.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] 2330001389 - Canary r-2026.03.20-euwest-12 marked healthy, resuming rollout per policy.
sre-oncall: leaving note: follow-up action: align helm values schema in repo at `charts/app/values.schema.json` to include splay validation and add preflight check to deploy-bot that diffs ConfigMap keys after templating.
alice: thanks all. I'll add the release-notes entry and assign follow-up to ben for preflight check ticket. :white_check_mark:
